image_handling: Downloaded observed public IMAGE URLs into ignored local scratch for measurement; no paths traced or imported.
published_artifact_scope: Numerical measurements, summary statistics and method metadata only; source images/contact sheets remain research-only.
classic_rule: Column E exact Y or Y*
category_handling: No source category labels are published or forward-filled. Seven row-range families are authored visual observations; column E flags define the two source populations.
components: 8-connected foreground; area>=4 px counted, raw counts retained
holes: Find enclosed background by 4-neighbor flood fill, then label 4-connected enclosed regions; count areas >=4 pixels and retain raw counts.
stroke_width: 2x Euclidean distance to background at Zhang-Suen centerline pixels; maximum-distance fallback point per fully collapsed compact component
angle: PCA within a 5-pixel radius; at least 4 points, principal eigenvalue >=1 and major/minor >=4. Angles modulo 180 degrees: horizontal <10 or >170; vertical >80 and <100; diagonals >33 and <57, or >123 and <147. Population fractions are weighted by qualifying samples.
symmetry: IoU of tight thresholded ink crop with left-right/top-bottom reflection or180degree rotation
component_spacing: Minimum Euclidean distance between ink-pixel centers belonging to distinct components; not exact clear-white gap
counter_width: Median of twice the Euclidean distance to surrounding ink at thinned enclosed-white medial pixels, with the same collapsed-component fallback; geometric voids are included without semantic classification.
sensitivity: All 137 images retain identical raw component and hole counts at thresholds 96, 128, and 160. Area change is (ink160 - ink96) / ink128.
precision: Per-row ratios retain Python floating-point precision; distribution summaries round to 5 decimal places. Linear-interpolated NumPy percentiles; per-group distributions weight glyphs equally unless explicitly pooled by orientation samples.

csv_conventions.row: Source column A row number; rows 3 through 139 inclusive.
csv_conventions.group: classic for exact column-E Y or Y*; new-only for exact N.
csv_conventions.sha256: SHA-256 of original PNG file bytes.
csv_conventions.pixel_sha256: SHA-256 of row-major uint8 RGBA bytes after compositing onto white; dimensions in width and height columns.
csv_conventions.bbox_shape_sha256: SHA-256 of Python string (height, width) followed by row-major boolean bytes of tight ink crop.
csv_conventions.bbox: [left, top, right-exclusive, bottom-exclusive] in source pixels.
csv_conventions.arrays: JSON arrays inside quoted CSV fields; component/hole areas sorted descending, angle histogram uses 12 bins of 15 degrees over [0, 180].
csv_conventions.fraction: Dimensionless values on [0,1] except explicitly named ratios; normalized stroke width divides by canvas height.
csv_conventions.widths_and_gaps: Source-pixel units; null/empty means no eligible component pair, enclosed hole, or orientation neighborhood.
csv_conventions.stroke_width_px_*: Per-glyph distribution of twice the distance transform sampled on its thinned centerline.
csv_conventions.threshold_counts: Raw component and hole counts, including regions smaller than 4 pixels.

artifact_hash_serialization: SHA-256 of UTF-8 bytes after normalizing CRLF to LF, with no byte-order mark. This applies only to the published CSV/JSON artifact hashes; source image hashes use original binary bytes.
